title: LDownRow
html:
定义组：指标替换与规约。有序参数：z959、z960、z961。

只在没有待删指标时定义的降位关系。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ LDownRow z959 z960 z961) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists c
  (exists t
    (exists u
      (and
        (exists z964 (and (@ Pair t u z964) (@ Pair c z964 z961)))
        (and
          (@ Nat c)
          (and
            (@ AnyRaw t)
            (or
              (exists z965
                (and
                  (@ TVar z965 t)
                  (or (and (in z965 c) (= u t)) (exists z966 (and (in c z965) (and (@ Succ z966 z965) (@ TVar z966 u)))))))
              (or
                (exists z965 (and (@ TConst z965 t) (= t u)))
                (or
                  (exists z968
                    (exists z969
                      (exists z974
                        (and
                          (@ ULam z968 t)
                          (and
                            (@ ULam z969 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Succ c z974)
                            (exists z975
                            (exists z976
                            (and
                            (in z975 z960)
                            (and (@ App z959 z975 z976) (exists z977 (and (@ Pair z968 z969 z977) (@ Pair z974 z977 z976)))))))))))))
                  (or
                    (exists z967
                      (exists z968
                        (exists z969
                          (exists z974
                            (and
                            (@ TLam z967 z968 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TLam z967 z969 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Succ c z974)
                            (exists z978
                            (exists z979
                            (and
                            (in z978 z960)
                            (and (@ App z959 z978 z979) (exists z980 (and (@ Pair z968 z969 z980) (@ Pair z974 z980 z979))))))))))))))
                    (exists z970
                      (exists z971
                        (exists z972
                          (exists z973
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z970 z971 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z972 z973 u)
                            (and
                            (exists z981
                            (exists z982
                            (and
                            (in z981 z960)
                            (and (@ App z959 z981 z982) (exists z983 (and (@ Pair z970 z972 z983) (@ Pair c z983 z982)))))))
                            (exists z984
                            (exists z985
                            (and
                            (in z984 z960)
                            (and (@ App z959 z984 z985) (exists z986 (and (@ Pair z971 z973 z986) (@ Pair c z986 z985))))))))))))))))))))))))

直接依赖
